parameters.content:
## Brand deal outreach — 2 of 2: work the replies, report weekly

**The job:** https://example.com/jobs/~022093291467589751915/

Two of the five things the post says the hire owns:

> Work the replies — handle responses and move interested brands to the right next step
> Report weekly — clean numbers so students and the team can see progress

**One hourly trigger drives both halves.** The weekly report sits behind a gate that is
true for one hour in 168. That is deliberate: two schedule triggers would need two
`config` nodes, and two config nodes disagree about a field name within a month.

Change the day and hour with `REPORT_DAY` and `REPORT_HOUR` in **config**.

## An unclear reply is urgent, not low priority

The rules are ordered and the **first match wins**, which is why `unsubscribe` and
`bounce` sit above `interested`. *"Please remove me, though the numbers were
interesting"* is an unsubscribe, and getting that precedence wrong is a complaint.

A reply matching nothing is `unclear` and goes to a **person**, with the same urgency
as an obvious yes — it is the one most likely to be a deal nobody recognised.

The demo batch contains two replies that match no rule, on purpose. A classifier
demonstrated only on replies it can classify is a classifier nobody has tested.

## Held pitches are in the weekly report

The report shows what the quality gates **cost**: how many pitches were written and not
sent, grouped by reason.

That number is meant to be argued with. If 22% are being held for thin brand records,
the answer is better research on the target list, not a looser audit — and the client
can only make that call if they can see the number.

Reply and interest rates are computed against what was **sent**, never against what was
written. Dividing by the bigger number flatters the run and is wrong.

## It runs before you have an account

No `SEND_API_KEY` -> a fabricated batch of nine replies, one of every class the rules
know plus two that match nothing.

No `AIRTABLE_API_KEY` -> a fabricated week of pitch log, so the weekly report has
something real-shaped to compute.

Nothing in either can be written anywhere. Press **Run it now**.
